stories.label: Iran-US-Israel war: Pentagon $200bn request, Saudi threatens action
stories.summary: Trump halts strikes 5 days. Congress pushing War Powers vote. First institutional pushback since war began Feb 28.

stories.label: Lebanon-Israel-Gaza: Hezbollah rebuilds, Gaza invisible war continues
stories.summary: Israel announces ground operations in Lebanon. Third active front. Over 1000 killed, 1 million displaced in 18 days before ground invasion.

stories.label: Hormuz crisis: Ras Laffan LNG attack, allies refuse escort, Pacific hit
stories.summary: Hormuz impact reaching UK middle class (40/week cuts) and deepening Pakistan austerity (high-octane fuel ban).

stories.label: WMO confirms 2025 hottest year warming millennia
stories.summary: WMO confirms 2025 hottest year on record. Warming locked in for thousands of years even if emissions stop.

stories.label: Belarus frees 250 political prisoners in sanctions bargain with US
stories.summary: Lukashenko releases largest batch of political prisoners (250) in exchange for US sanctions relief.

stories.label: Venezuela: interim president purges military leadership post-Maduro
stories.summary: Delcy Rodriguez replaces all senior military commanders after US-backed ouster of Maduro.

stories.label: Japan PM Takaichi seeks Kim Jong Un summit on abductions
stories.summary: Takaichi told Trump she wants direct talks with Kim on Japanese abductees. First since Koizumi 2004.

stories.label: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS has extreme deuterium levels
stories.summary: Third confirmed interstellar object. Deuterium 30-40x Earth ocean levels.

stories.label: China joins nuclear energy pledge, new ecological code
stories.summary: China joins nuclear energy pledge and introduces comprehensive ecological code.

stories.label: Pakistan establishes Social Media Protection and Regulatory Authority
stories.summary: SMPRA established under amended cybercrime law. Government lawyer appointed chairman.

stories.label: LaGuardia: two pilots killed in runway collision
stories.summary: Air Canada jet collided with ground vehicle at LaGuardia, killing both pilots. Airport shut down.

stories.label: Ukraine strikes Russian energy infrastructure deep inside territory
stories.summary: Ukraine struck Primorsk oil terminal on Baltic Sea, major crude export hub far from front lines.

stories.label: Antisemitic hate crimes surge across Europe during war
stories.summary: Jewish charity ambulances set ablaze in London. War poison reaching diaspora communities.

stories.label: Hong Kong authoritarianism: NSL trials + phone password law
stories.summary: Police can now demand phone passwords (1yr jail for refusal) under new national security rules. Coincides with ongoing NSL subversion trials where activist called one-party rule regression.

stories.label: Lionel Jospin dies at 88
stories.summary: Former French PM (1997-2002) dies. Architect of 35-hour work week.

stories.label: Australia ABC staff first strike in 20 years
stories.summary: Staff at Australia public broadcaster to strike for first time in two decades.

stories.label: FDA approval paradox: C. diff treatment harder after regulation
stories.summary: FDA approved fecal microbiota treatments but made them nearly impossible to access.

stories.label: Meta 80B metaverse declared dead
stories.summary: Meta spent 80B on metaverse, biggest failed tech bet in history.

stories.label: Google Maps fails to capture informal cities
stories.summary: Cities resisting Google mapping. Informal settlements make poorest populations digitally invisible.

stories.label: US lobby firm $2m contract to whitewash Libya's Haftar
stories.summary: Ballard Partners (staffed by ex-Trump officials) gets $2m to represent Haftar, found liable for war crimes by US court in 2022. Trump advisor Boulos brokering power-sharing deal bypassing elections.

stories.label: Uganda NGO crackdown creates service gaps
stories.summary: Uganda crackdown on NGOs creating cascading service gaps in health, education. Follows Bobi Wine fleeing to US.

stories.label: Nigeria dual crisis: Cross River gas explosion + Kwara bomb
stories.summary: 60 burn victims from gas explosion in Cross River state. Same day, bomb detonated on Kwara-Niger road. Dual infrastructure/security crisis.

stories.label: Grab acquires Foodpanda Taiwan for $600m
stories.summary: Singapore super-app Grab expands beyond SE Asia for first time. Foodpanda Taiwan was €1.5B GMV and already profitable.

stories.label: Uganda Lake Victoria cargo trade collapsed from 30% to near zero
stories.summary: Lake Victoria cargo once carried ~30% of Uganda's trade, now near zero. Structural infrastructure failure.

stories.label: Doctronic AI doctor raises $40m, chatbot prescriptions in Utah
stories.summary: Doctronic raised $65M total. First-in-nation chatbot prescription renewals in Utah. $39/visit, $10M revenue, expanding to health systems.

stories.label: Iranian state hackers Handala back, hit US medical firm Stryker
stories.summary: Handala formally attributed to Iran intelligence ministry. Escalated from trolling Israel to destructive cyberattack on US medical firm Stryker.

stories.label: Russia piles fines on Telegram, 40M+ rubles unpaid
stories.summary: Telegram fined for 2 more violations, total unpaid fines exceed 40M rubles. Pressured from both Russia and Western governments post-Durov arrest.

stories.label: Kenya grants amnesty to citizens who fought for Russia in Ukraine
stories.summary: Kenya will pardon citizens who illegally joined Russia military. Recruitment pipelines exploited economic desperation.

stories.label: Imran Khan attacks judiciary from prison, family access denied
stories.summary: Imran Khan uses son Kasim as channel to attack judiciary on Eid. Wife Bushra Bibi in 24-hour isolation.

stories.label: Trans-Saharan gas pipeline advances as Hormuz crisis boosts demand
stories.summary: Niger Sonidep says TSGP to be concretised very soon. Hormuz disruption makes decades-stalled project suddenly viable.

stories.label: Pompeii graffiti research reconstructs ordinary Roman life
stories.summary: Researchers shift from grand structures to scratched messages, reconstructing inner lives of ordinary Romans.

stories.label: FPGA recreation of 3dfx Voodoo chip
stories.summary: Engineer recreated iconic 1996 3dfx Voodoo graphics chip on modern FPGA using contemporary RTL tools.

stories.label: European far-right Patriots bloc assembles in Budapest
stories.summary: Patriots for Europe grand assembly in Budapest ahead of Hungarian elections.

stories.label: Nigeria: 15 arrested after viral sexual assault videos
stories.summary: Viral videos spark StopRapingWomen, 15 arrested.

stories.label: European nations exploring France nuclear umbrella
stories.summary: Allies exploring France nuclear deterrent as US reliability questioned.

stories.label: ICE agents deployed at airports as DHS shutdown guts TSA
stories.summary: ICE filling in at airport security due to shutdown.

stories.label: String theory: still best hope for theory of everything?
stories.summary: Quanta examines latest string theory developments.

stories.label: Ice core reveals low CO2 during warm Pliocene
stories.summary: First direct Pliocene measurements show CO2 lower than expected.

stories.label: Tencent integrates ClawBot into WeChat amid OpenClaw craze
stories.summary: WeChat adds AI claw-machine game. Privacy warnings.

stories.label: Nigerian artists earn less as Spotify listenership grows
stories.summary: Pro-rata model means more streams divide smaller pool.

stories.label: CcHUB training 340k Nigerians for global gig economy
stories.summary: GATEWAY program across 10 states for digital skills.

stories.label: Happy Pay ad-supported BNPL raises 5M in South Africa
stories.summary: Ad-supported BNPL model raises 5M from Partech.

stories.label: UK middle-income families cutting spending as war costs hit
stories.summary: Households on 55k cutting 40/week on leisure.

stories.label: Argentina marks 50 years since 1976 coup, Church breaks silence
stories.summary: Argentine Catholic Church says never again on 50th anniversary of 1976 coup. Historic break from institutional silence on complicity in Dirty War.

stories.label: South Korea signals self-reliant defense as US stretched
stories.summary: Acting president Lee stresses self-reliant defense citing very complex global situation. 28,500 US troops may be needed elsewhere.

stories.label: Resolv stablecoin exploited for 5M, crashes 70%
stories.summary: Resolv stablecoin crashed 70% after attacker exploited minting vulnerability to extract 25M in ETH.

stories.label: GCC emerging as global AI capital hub
stories.summary: Gulf states positioning as AI hub with sovereign wealth. AMI Labs hits 3.5B valuation with Shorooq backing.

stories.label: Singapore: basketball-court green space cools 5C
stories.summary: Singapore study finds green space as small as a basketball court can cool surroundings by up to 5C.

stories.label: WHO pandemic talks disrupted by war, Malaysia joins virtually
stories.summary: Malaysia joins WHO pandemic preparedness talks virtually because war makes Geneva travel impractical.

stories.label: India rupee record low on oil shock
stories.summary: Indian rupee hits record low as oil above 112 strains 85 percent crude import dependency.

stories.label: Gold crashes 9 consecutive days
stories.summary: Gold fallen nine consecutive days during active war. Unprecedented breakdown of safe haven thesis.

stories.label: PTI frustration over Imran Khan release delay
stories.summary: PTI leaders publicly frustrated with delays in Imran Khan release movement after 80+ days detention.

stories.label: Chinese surgery robot outperforms humans
stories.summary: Chinese surgical robot outperformed human surgeons in brain imaging cutting time by 29 percent.

stories.label: Young workers restructuring careers around AI
stories.summary: Young workers actively choosing AI-resistant roles and skills before mass layoffs materialize.

stories.label: South Korea 55 percent stablecoin plunge
stories.summary: Korean retail investors rotating from crypto to discounted stocks. 55 percent stablecoin drawdown.

stories.label: China 1000m tourist submersible
stories.summary: China building first tourist submersible for 1000m depth. Same pressure hull tech as military subs.

stories.label: SBF parents claim no money lost creditors dispute
stories.summary: SBF parents claim on CNN no customer money lost. FTX creditors directly contradict.

stories.label: IAEA chief: nuclear situation worse than 1970s
stories.summary: Grossi says three nuclear facilities struck or targeted in two countries in under a month.
